knowledge.application_limit: Static source context is not proof that this path executed or caused a particular incident.
knowledge.scope: Official Shop source at the pinned commit; deployed-version equality and execution require incident evidence
knowledge.text: A failed PlaceOrder marks the frontend span ERROR. Its response mapping treats a charge-failure prefix without Unavailable or Internal as HTTP 422; other caught order-placement failures become HTTP 500. This is message-based classification, not independent cause verification.

knowledge.title: Service version is a separate attribute
knowledge.application_limit: A source commit and a telemetry service-name match do not establish deployed-source equality.
knowledge.scope: Telemetry interpretation across authorized services; apply the producer's actual convention version
knowledge.text: service.version describes the component version, and its format is not standardized. The logical service name alone does not identify the version.

knowledge.title: Error classification depends on the operation
knowledge.application_limit: This development guidance is interpretation context, not a guarantee that historical instrumentation complied with it.
knowledge.scope: Telemetry interpretation across authorized services; apply the producer's actual convention version
knowledge.text: An error code needs operation context: even HTTP 404 may be expected when checking existence. Current guidance says handled or retried errors should not mark an overall operation as failed when it completes gracefully.

knowledge.title: RPC method, outcome, and convention version
knowledge.application_limit: Interpret original field names under their producer's convention version; do not assume a timeout proves a server-side code failure.
knowledge.scope: Telemetry interpretation across authorized services; apply the producer's actual convention version
knowledge.text: RPC spans describe remote calls with method and outcome information. Client-side duration can include retries. The current conventions distinguish errors occurring before a response from returned error status codes and document migration behavior for older instrumentation.
knowledge.source_section: RPC client span; migration notice; error.type

knowledge.title: Error and unset span status
knowledge.application_limit: An ERROR span does not identify an initiating cause. Missing spans or attributes do not prove that the operation did not happen.
knowledge.scope: Telemetry interpretation across authorized services; apply the producer's actual convention version
knowledge.text: Unset is the default span status. Error records an error in the operation; Ok records validated successful completion. Non-recording spans discard added data, and recording alone does not guarantee export to the backend.
